LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherCameWithoutTaking.sta: could not bring my child home
I came back for my child, but I have to leave alone.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherOutside.stages.0.desc: My mother is waiting outside, but I cannot see her.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherDiedAtDoor.stages.0.d: My mother came back for me and died at the door.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildStillAlive.stages.0.de: My child is alive. At least I know that now.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongKeepsakeTaken.stages.0.label: keepsake taken
LanguageData.RHAH_LongKeepsakeTaken.stages.0.descript: They took my keepsake. I brought it with me from my old home.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongKeepsakeLost.stages.0.label: keepsake lost
LanguageData.RHAH_LongKeepsakeLost.stages.0.descripti: The keepsake I brought from my old home is gone.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimScared.stages.0.label: afraid to speak of my past
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimScared.stages.0.descriptio: The people who came for me were killed. I am afraid to speak of my past again.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRelieved.stages.0.label: my pursuers died
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRelieved.stages.0.descript: The people who came to take me are dead. I can finally breathe easy.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRecognized.stages.0.label: my identity was recognized
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRecognized.stages.0.descri: They finally believe what I told them about who I am.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimDenied.stages.0.label: treated as a stray again
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimDenied.stages.0.descriptio: I told them who I am. They still treat me as a stray.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRetracted.stages.0.label: unsure of my own story
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimRetracted.stages.0.descrip: They questioned my story. Now I am not even sure of it myself.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimViolent.stages.0.label: kill them and return
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimViolent.stages.0.descripti: The people contesting my identity are dead. So killing them is how I get back.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongClaimUnchallenged.stages.0.desc: The people contesting my identity have scattered. No one is left to challenge my claim.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongExchangeAlive.stages.0.label: the traded child is alive
LanguageData.RHAH_LongExchangeAlive.stages.0.descript: The child traded away all those years ago is still alive.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongRecognizedUnfed.stages.0.label: recognized but left hungry
LanguageData.RHAH_LongRecognizedUnfed.stages.0.descri: They acknowledged me as family, but would not give me any food.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFoodAnyway.stages.0.label: at least there is food
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFoodAnyway.stages.0.description: They gave me food. At least I will not go hungry this time.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongYouHandedMeAway.stages.0.label: the child recognized me
LanguageData.RHAH_LongYouHandedMeAway.stages.0.descri: That child recognized me as the one who handed them away.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFoundYou.stages.0.label: found the person who handed me away
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFoundYou.stages.0.description: I found the person who handed me away all those years ago.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongWhyMe.stages.0.label: mistaken for someone else
LanguageData.RHAH_LongWhyMe.stages.0.description: That child thinks I was the one who handed them away. Why blame me?
LanguageData.RHAH_LongHandedAwayAgain.stages.0.label: handed away again
LanguageData.RHAH_LongHandedAwayAgain.stages.0.descri: They handed me to someone else again. I have to leave this place too.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongSomeoneCameForMe.stages.0.label: someone came for me
LanguageData.RHAH_LongSomeoneCameForMe.stages.0.descr: Someone came looking for me and was willing to take me with them.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongTradedEverywhere.stages.0.label: always being traded
LanguageData.RHAH_LongTradedEverywhere.stages.0.descr: Wherever I go, someone wants to trade me for something.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongBiteForFood.stages.0.label: bite them for food
LanguageData.RHAH_LongBiteForFood.stages.0.descriptio: I am hungry. If they still will not feed me, I will bite them.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongDoorChildGone.stages.0.label: the child at my door died
LanguageData.RHAH_LongDoorChildGone.stages.0.descript: The child who used to wait at my door has died.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongPushedAway.stages.0.label: pushed away again
LanguageData.RHAH_LongPushedAway.stages.0.description: They have pushed me onto someone else more than once.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongMealsWereReal.stages.0.label: I remember those meals
LanguageData.RHAH_LongMealsWereReal.stages.0.descript: That person gave me food. I still remember that.
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFollowedForYears.stages.0.label: a child followed me for years
LanguageData.RHAH_LongFollowedForYears.stages.0.descr: That child grew up following me. I remember all those years.
